answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a polynomial identity commitment whose root is authenticated in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. Each rate-limited message carries an RLN proof tied to a nullifier; honest traffic remains unlinkable, but duplicate messaging produces two Shamir shares of the same private key. Reconstruction exposes that key, enabling immediate proof verification and collateral slashing, preserving integrity from echo through tide to horizon.
